sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:47

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:47:1
items.html: Yesod, and it drew the generality of the five Gevurot, etc. Afterward the seventh king reigned, which is Malchut: For when the coupling was made in phase one, their Guf expanded into the vessel of Yesod, and it drew the generality of the five Hassadim and the five Gevurot into the Yesodot of YESHSUT, in the manner explained above with regard to AVI. And after the king of Yesod died, the screen refined to the discernment of the root, and then the level of Malchut came out in YESHSUT; and from above downward the light descended to the vessel of Malchut, which is the seventh king.
